user.title: Project Cyder
user.description: Select the ESPHome CYD device whose alert actions should be used.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure CYD device
reconfigure.description: After installing firmware with the alert actions, select the ESPHome device again and reload this entry.

error.invalid_rules: One or more alert rules are invalid. Check their entity, threshold, priority, title, and message.

abort.already_configured: This ESPHome device is already configured.
abort.wrong_device: This entry must remain linked to its originally selected ESPHome device. Remove and re-add the integration to monitor a different device.

dashboard.title: Dashboard and usage
dashboard.description: Choose the power and energy sensors shown on the display. Power is converted to kW for the main value and graph, and to W for the optional metrics. Claude usage sensors keep their configured units.

alerts.title: Alert rules
alerts.description: Add threshold rules. Comparisons are strict; hysteresis controls when an active rule clears.

error.invalid_dashboard: Check the selected entities and display names. Up to four named power metrics are supported.

init.title: Reconfigure the CYD ESPHome device
init.description: This integration needs the device-prefixed display_alert, clear_alert, and dismiss_alert services. Check that this entry selects the correct ESPHome device, install firmware exposing all three actions, then continue to verify the registered services.

abort.entry_not_found: The Project Cyder entry no longer exists.

dashboard_action_unavailable.title: Dashboard updates are unavailable for {device_name}
dashboard_action_unavailable.description: The selected ESPHome device does not expose the update_dashboard action. Install the updated CYD firmware, then reload Project Cyder.

init.title: Reload the CYD integration
init.description: After installing firmware with the update_dashboard action, continue to reload the selected ESPHome device.

abort.entry_not_found: The Project Cyder entry no longer exists.
